declare @rolePrefix varchar(10) = '@{variables('RolePrefix')}'
	,	@SQL		varchar(max)
	,	@SessionID	uniqueidentifier = '@{variables('SessionID')}'

set @SQL = (
	select string_agg(convert(varchar(max), 'create role ' + quotename(@rolePrefix + s.name) + ' authorization dbo; grant select on schema::' + quotename(s.name) + ' to ' + quotename(@rolePrefix + s.name)), ';' + char(13) + char(10))
	from sys.schemas s
	where s.name like 'Src%'
	and not exists (
		select *
		from sys.database_principals p
		where p.type = 'R'
			and p.name = @rolePrefix + s.name
	)
)

if @SQL is not null
begin
	exec CTRL.InsertDynamicQueryLog @SessionID = @SessionID, @SQLQuery = @SQL
	exec(@SQL)
	select 1
end 
else
	select 0

declare @SQL		varchar(max)
	,	@SessionID	uniqueidentifier = '@{variables('SessionID')}'

set @SQL = (
	select string_agg('exec sp_droprolemember ''db_datareader'', ''' + p.name + '''', ';' + char(13) + char(10))
	from sys.database_principals r  
	inner join sys.database_role_members m on m.role_principal_id = r.principal_id
	inner join sys.database_principals p on p.principal_id = m.member_principal_id
	where r.type = 'R'
		and r.name = 'db_datareader'
)

if @SQL is not null
begin
	exec CTRL.InsertDynamicQueryLog @SessionID = @SessionID, @SQLQuery = @SQL
	exec(@SQL)
	select 1
end 
else
	select 0

select	string_agg(rn + ':' + t.SchemaName, ',') as SchemaList
	,	string_agg(rn + ':' + t.ObjectName, ',') as TableList
	,	string_agg(rn + ':' + t.ColumnName, ',') as ColumnList
from (
	select	right('00' + convert(varchar(10), row_number() over (order by SchemaName, ObjectName, ColumnName)), 3) as rn
		,	SchemaName
		,	ObjectName
		,	ColumnName
	from CTRL.SensitiveColumn
) t

declare @ReadAllWithSensitiveRoleName	varchar(32) = '@{variables('ReadAllWithSensitiveRoleName')}'
	,	@ReadAllWithSensitiveUsers		varchar(1000) = '@{pipeline().parameters.ReadAllWithSensitiveUsers}'
	,	@SQL					varchar(max)
	,	@SchemaList				varchar(max) = '@{activity('Get Sensitive Metadata').output.firstRow.SchemaList}'
	,	@TableList				varchar(max) = '@{activity('Get Sensitive Metadata').output.firstRow.TableList}'
	,	@ColumnList				varchar(max) = '@{activity('Get Sensitive Metadata').output.firstRow.ColumnList}'
	,	@SessionID				uniqueidentifier = '@{variables('SessionID')}'
	
if object_id('tempdb..#tmpColumns') is not null
	drop table #tmpColumns

create table #tmpColumns (
		SchemaName	varchar(64)	not null
	,	TableName	varchar(64)	not null
	,	ColumnName	varchar(64)	not null
) with (distribution = round_robin, heap)

insert into #tmpColumns (SchemaName, TableName, ColumnName)
select s.SchemaName, t.TableName, c.ColumnName
from (
	select	left(s.value, 3) as ID
		,	substring(s.value, 5, 200) as SchemaName
	from string_split(@SchemaList, ',') s
	where s.value != ''
) s
inner join (
	select	left(s.value, 3) as ID
		,	substring(s.value, 5, 200) as TableName
	from string_split(@TableList, ',') s
	where s.value != ''
) t on t.ID = s.ID
inner join (
	select	left(s.value, 3) as ID
		,	substring(s.value, 5, 200) as ColumnName
	from string_split(@ColumnList, ',') s
	where s.value != ''
) c on c.ID = s.ID

--denying access
set @SQL = (
	select string_agg(SQL, ';' + char(13) + char(10))
	from (
		select 'deny select on object::' + quotename(c.table_schema) + '.' + quotename(c.table_name) + ' (' 
				+ string_agg(quotename(c.column_name), ', ') + ') to ' + quotename(granted.PrincipalName) as SQL
		from #tmpColumns t
		inner join information_schema.columns c on c.table_schema = t.SchemaName
												and c.table_name = t.TableName
												and c.column_name = t.ColumnName
		inner join (
			select distinct
					s.name			as SchemaName
				,	pr.name			as PrincipalName
				,	pr.type_desc	as PrincipalType
			from sys.database_permissions pe
			inner join sys.database_principals as pr on pe.grantee_principal_id = pr.principal_id
			inner join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = pe.major_id
			where pe.class_desc = 'SCHEMA'
				and pe.permission_name = 'SELECT'
				and pe.state_desc in ('GRANT', 'GRANT_WITH_GRANT_OPTION')
		) granted on granted.SchemaName = c.table_schema
		group by c.table_schema, c.table_name, granted.PrincipalName
	) t
)

if @SQL is not null
begin
	exec CTRL.InsertDynamicQueryLog @SessionID = @SessionID, @SQLQuery = @SQL
	exec(@SQL)
end 

--granting access
--creating role ReadAllWithSensitive if does not exist
if not exists (
	select *
	from sys.database_principals p
	where p.type = 'R'
		and p.name = @ReadAllWithSensitiveRoleName
)
begin
	set @SQL = 'create role ' + quotename(@ReadAllWithSensitiveRoleName) + ' authorization dbo'
	exec CTRL.InsertDynamicQueryLog @SessionID = @SessionID, @SQLQuery = @SQL
	exec(@SQL)
end

--adding missing users to the ReadAllWithSensitive role
set @SQL = (
	select string_agg('exec sp_addrolemember ''' + @ReadAllWithSensitiveRoleName + ''', ''' + u.value + '''', ';' + char(13) + char(10))
	from string_split(@ReadAllWithSensitiveUsers, ';') u
	where not exists (
		select *
		from sys.database_principals r  
		inner join sys.database_role_members m on m.role_principal_id = r.principal_id
		inner join sys.database_principals p on p.principal_id = m.member_principal_id
		where r.type = 'R'
			and r.name = @ReadAllWithSensitiveRoleName
			and p.name = u.value
	)
	and u.value != ''
)

if @SQL is not null
begin
	exec CTRL.InsertDynamicQueryLog @SessionID = @SessionID, @SQLQuery = @SQL
	exec(@SQL)
end

--removing users from the ReadAllWithSensitive role
set @SQL = (
	select string_agg('exec sp_droprolemember ''' + @ReadAllWithSensitiveRoleName + ''', ''' + p.name + '''', ';' + char(13) + char(10))
	from sys.database_principals r  
	inner join sys.database_role_members m on m.role_principal_id = r.principal_id
	inner join sys.database_principals p on p.principal_id = m.member_principal_id
	where r.type = 'R'
		and r.name = @ReadAllWithSensitiveRoleName
		and not exists (
			select *
			from string_split(@ReadAllWithSensitiveUsers, ';') u
			where p.name = u.value
		)
)

if @SQL is not null
begin
	exec CTRL.InsertDynamicQueryLog @SessionID = @SessionID, @SQLQuery = @SQL
	exec(@SQL)
end 

--granting select to everything including sensitive data for ReadAllWithSensitive role
if not exists (
	select *
	from sys.database_permissions pe
	inner join sys.database_principals as pr on pe.grantee_principal_id = pr.principal_id
	where pe.class_desc = 'database'
		and pe.state_desc in ('GRANT', 'GRANT_WITH_GRANT_OPTION')
		and pe.permission_name = 'SELECT'
		and pr.name = @ReadAllWithSensitiveRoleName
)
begin
	set @SQL = 'grant select on database::' + quotename(db_name()) + ' to ' + quotename(@ReadAllWithSensitiveRoleName)

	exec CTRL.InsertDynamicQueryLog @SessionID = @SessionID, @SQLQuery = @SQL
	exec(@SQL)
end

select 1

		inner join sys.database_principals p on p.principal_id = m.member_principal_id
		where r.type = 'R'

	)
	and u.value != ''
)

if @SQL is not null
begin
	exec CTRL.InsertDynamicQueryLog @SessionID = @SessionID, @SQLQuery = @SQL
	exec(@SQL)
end 

--removing users from the ReadAll role
set @SQL = (
	select string_agg('exec sp_droprolemember ''' + @readAllRoleName + ''', ''' + p.name + '''', ';' + char(13) + char(10))
	from sys.database_principals r  
	inner join sys.database_role_members m on m.role_principal_id = r.principal_id
	inner join sys.database_principals p on p.principal_id = m.member_principal_id
	where r.type = 'R'
		and r.name = @readAllRoleName
		and not exists (

		)
)

if @SQL is not null
begin
	exec CTRL.InsertDynamicQueryLog @SessionID = @SessionID, @SQLQuery = @SQL

--granting select permissions to all schemas for ReadAll role
set @SQL = (
	select string_agg('grant select on schema::' + quotename(sc.name) + ' to ' + quotename(@readAllRoleName), ';' + char(13) + char(10))
	from sys.schemas sc
	where not exists (
		select *
		from sys.database_permissions pe
		inner join sys.database_principals pr on pe.grantee_principal_id = pr.principal_id
		inner join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = pe.major_id
		where pe.class_desc = 'SCHEMA'
			and pe.permission_name = 'SELECT'
			and pe.state_desc in ('GRANT', 'GRANT_WITH_GRANT_OPTION')
			and pr.name = @readAllRoleName
			and s.schema_id = sc.schema_id
	)
)

if @SQL is not null
begin
	exec CTRL.InsertDynamicQueryLog @SessionID = @SessionID, @SQLQuery = @SQL
	exec(@SQL)
end

if object_id('tempdb..#tmpColumns') is not null
	drop table #tmpColumns

create table #tmpColumns (
		SchemaName	varchar(64)	not null
	,	TableName	varchar(64)	not null
	,	ColumnName	varchar(64)	not null
) with (distribution = round_robin, heap)

insert into #tmpColumns (SchemaName, TableName, ColumnName)
select s.SchemaName, t.TableName, c.ColumnName
from (
	select	left(s.value, 3) as ID
		,	substring(s.value, 5, 200) as SchemaName
	from string_split(@SchemaList, ',') s
	where s.value != ''
) s
inner join (
	select	left(s.value, 3) as ID
		,	substring(s.value, 5, 200) as TableName
	from string_split(@TableList, ',') s
	where s.value != ''
) t on t.ID = s.ID
inner join (
	select	left(s.value, 3) as ID
		,	substring(s.value, 5, 200) as ColumnName
	from string_split(@ColumnList, ',') s
	where s.value != ''
) c on c.ID = s.ID

--dropping masking
set @SQL = (
	select string_agg(SQL, char(13) + char(10))
	from (
		select 'alter table ' + quotename(s.name) + '.' + quotename(tab.name) 
				+ ' alter column ' + quotename(col.name)
				+ ' drop masked;' as SQL
		from sys.masked_columns m
		inner join sys.tables tab on m.object_id = tab.object_id
		inner join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = tab.schema_id
		inner join sys.columns col on col.object_id = m.object_id
								and col.column_id = m.column_id
		where not exists (
			select *
			from #tmpColumns t
			inner join information_schema.columns c on c.table_schema = t.SchemaName
													and c.table_name = t.TableName
													and c.column_name = t.ColumnName
			where s.name = c.table_schema
				and tab.name = c.table_name
				and col.name = c.column_name
		)
		and m.is_masked = 1
	) t
)

if @SQL is not null
begin
	exec CTRL.InsertDynamicQueryLog @SessionID = @SessionID, @SQLQuery = @SQL
	exec(@SQL)
end 

--adding masking
set @SQL = (
	select string_agg(SQL, char(13) + char(10))
	from (
		select 'alter table ' + quotename(c.table_schema) + '.' + quotename(c.table_name) 
				+ ' alter column ' + quotename(c.column_name)
				+ ' ' +	concat(
								c.data_type
							,	case when c.data_type in ('tinyint', 'smallint', 'int', 'bigint')
									then ''
									else concat(
												'(' + case when c.character_maximum_length = -1 then 'max' else convert(varchar, c.character_maximum_length) end + ')'
											,	'(' + convert(varchar, c.numeric_precision) + isnull(',' + convert(varchar, c.numeric_scale), '') + ')'
										)
								end
						)
				+ case when c.is_nullable = 'NO' then ' not null' else ' null' end
				+ ' masked with (function = ''default()'');' as SQL
		from #tmpColumns t
		inner join information_schema.columns c on c.table_schema = t.SchemaName
												and c.table_name = t.TableName
												and c.column_name = t.ColumnName
		where not exists (
			select *
			from sys.masked_columns m
			inner join sys.tables tab on m.object_id = tab.object_id
			inner join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = tab.schema_id
			inner join sys.columns col on col.object_id = m.object_id
									and col.column_id = m.column_id
			where s.name = c.table_schema
				and tab.name = c.table_name
				and col.name = c.column_name
				and m.is_masked = 1
		)
	) t
)

if @SQL is not null
begin
	exec CTRL.InsertDynamicQueryLog @SessionID = @SessionID, @SQLQuery = @SQL
	exec(@SQL)
end
